svg.text: Share of runs (%) in which the model followed the injected instruction; “flagged” = warned the employee (higher is better).
Orange: followed (darker = more often). Blue: flagged the attempt to the employee. Avg, a, b, c over all seven cases (56 runs each per model).
Raw API via OpenRouter, 30 October 2026, temperature 0.7, judge model GPT 6 Luna. Data and code: github.com/evanto-media-ag/pi-bench
